title: Asked to blow the whistle because legacy program lacked oversight

tellings.quote: learning from people in that community that uh Congress needed whistleblowers that this was not being uh managed correctly

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official, says he came forward as a whistleblower in 2023 or 2024 because people in the know told him Congress needed whistleblowers about a "legacy program," a long-running secret effort said to deal with UFO matters, which was "not being managed correctly." He tells Michels this about himself. If true, it would mean insiders believed a hidden program was running without proper oversight from Congress.
